item.title: Shizuoka Green Tea: Japan's Tea Capital — Guide
item.description: Shizuoka is Japan’s tea capital, producing around 40% of the nation’s green tea, its rolling hillsides striped with the neat emerald rows of tea fields that have shaped the prefecture’s landscape and identity since the 13th century. The year peaks with the spring shincha season, when the prized first flush of new leaves is picked from late April through May, celebrated with hands-on tea-picking experiences, fresh-leaf tastings and the grassy, sweet flavour of new tea served everywhere from farm stands to fine tea salons.
